articles.title: BSEC Issues New Circular on Mutual Fund Disclosure Requirements
articles.summary: The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission has issued a new circular requiring all mutual funds to provide enhanced disclosure about their portfolio holdings and fee structures. The circular aims to improve transparency for retail investors in Bangladesh. All asset management companies must comply within 90 days of issuance.

articles.title: National Savings Directorate Announces Revised Interest Rates for Sonchayapatra
articles.summary: The National Savings Directorate has announced revised interest rates for various Sonchayapatra schemes effective from December 2024. The rates apply to new purchases of savings certificates including Sanchaypatra, Pensioner Sanchaypatra, and Paribar Sanchaypatra. Existing certificate holders continue with their originally contracted rates.

articles.title: Bangladesh Bank Monetary Policy Statement for H2 FY2024-25
articles.summary: Bangladesh Bank has released its monetary policy statement for the second half of fiscal year 2024-25. The statement outlines policy repo rates, reserve requirements, and liquidity management measures for the banking sector. Key focus areas include inflation control and private sector credit growth.

articles.title: Understanding Sonchayapatra: A Beginner Guide to Bangladesh Savings Certificates
articles.summary: This explainer covers the basics of Sonchayapatra savings certificates in Bangladesh. Learn about different types including Sanchaypatra, Pensioner Sanchaypatra, Paribar Sanchaypatra, and how they work. The guide explains eligibility, purchase process, and redemption rules in simple language for new savers.

articles.title: Top Mutual Funds in Bangladesh: Performance Overview Q3 2024
articles.summary: An overview of mutual fund performance in Bangladesh for the third quarter of 2024. The article covers major asset management companies, their fund sizes, and general market trends. Readers are encouraged to consult official fund documents and licensed advisors before making any investment decisions.

articles.title: DSE Trading Volume Reaches New High as Market Sentiment Improves
articles.summary: Dhaka Stock Exchange trading volume reached a new high in November 2024 as market sentiment improved across key sectors. The article covers trading statistics, top gainers, and market capitalization changes. This is general market information only and does not constitute investment advice.

articles.title: How to Open a Sonchayapatra Account: Step-by-Step Process
articles.summary: A step-by-step guide on opening a Sonchayapatra account through designated banks and post offices in Bangladesh. The guide covers required documents, application forms, nomination rules, and the encashment process. All procedures follow National Savings Directorate guidelines.

articles.title: BSEC Directs Listed Companies to Publish Quarterly Financial Reports on Time
articles.summary: The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission has directed all listed companies to ensure timely publication of quarterly financial reports. The directive emphasizes compliance with disclosure norms and sets penalties for delayed submissions. Companies must publish reports within the stipulated timeframe after each quarter ends.

articles.title: Growth Funds vs Mutual Funds: Key Differences for Bangladeshi Investors
articles.summary: This article explains the key differences between growth funds and mutual funds available in Bangladesh. It covers investment objectives, risk profiles, fund structures, and regulatory oversight. The content is purely educational and does not recommend any specific fund or investment.

articles.title: National Savings Certificate Rates Remain Stable in Q4 2024
articles.summary: National savings certificate rates have remained stable during the fourth quarter of 2024 according to the National Savings Directorate. The article covers rates for 3-year, 5-year pensioner, and family savings certificates. Readers should verify current rates at their nearest NSD office or designated bank branch.

articles.title: IPO Market Activity in Bangladesh: What Investors Should Know
articles.summary: An overview of initial public offering activity in the Bangladesh capital market during 2024. The article covers recent IPOs, subscription statistics, and listing procedures. This is educational content only and does not constitute a recommendation to invest in any IPO.

articles.title: Understanding Dividend Yields from Mutual Funds in Bangladesh
articles.summary: This explainer covers how dividend yields work for mutual funds in Bangladesh, including how dividends are declared, distributed, and taxed. The guide helps readers understand dividend payout ratios and what factors affect mutual fund dividend distributions. Not investment advice.

articles.title: Bangladesh Bank Issues Guidelines on Digital Banking Transactions
articles.summary: Bangladesh Bank has issued new guidelines for digital banking transactions covering mobile banking, internet banking, and card-based payments. The guidelines aim to enhance security and consumer protection in digital financial services. All scheduled banks must implement the guidelines by the specified deadline.
